title: Homogeneous fraction atlas for an affine-basis graded line map
statement: Let $h:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism and $A$ affine-basis quasi-coherent graded algebra data on $S$. Let $L$ be an invertible module on $T$ and $\psi$ a relative graded line map [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map] generating everywhere. Supply sections $P(l,n)\in\Gamma(W,L^{\otimes n})$ for all opens $W$ and $l\in\Gamma(W,L)$, satisfying $P(l,0)=1$ and $P(l,n+1)=l\otimes P(l,n)$. For every affine $U\subseteq S$, affine $W\subseteq h^{-1}U$, and $l\in\Gamma(W,L)$, supply coefficients $c_{U,W,l}(a)\in\mathcal O_T(W)$ for $a\in A(U)_n$. Assume that for every free frame $l$ [def-sc-local-free-generator] they satisfy $c_{U,W,l}(a)P(l,n)=\psi_U(a)|_W$. There exists $F:T\to\operatorname{Proj}_S(A)$ satisfying $\psi.\mathrm{IsCanonicalMap}(F)$. For every such $U,W,l$, every $d>0$ and $e\in A(U)_d$, there is a ring map $\rho:(A(U)_e)_0\to\mathcal O_T(W)[1/c(e)]$, with degree-zero homogeneous localization as in [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], such that $\rho(a/e^n)=c(a)/c(e)^n$ for $a\in A(U)_{nd}$. It sends every structural scalar $r/1$ to $h^\sharp(r)/1$, and its spectrum map followed by $D_+(e)\to\operatorname{Proj}_S(A)$ equals the canonical map $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_T(W)[1/c(e)])\to T$ followed by $F$.

proof.text: Normalize coefficients using the free tensor-power frames. Their unit and product equations define the direct-sum ring map, hence the ordinary localization map restricted to the degree-zero homogeneous localization. Compute its homogeneous fractions and its values on base scalars. All of this is proved by the private helpers in the item module.

proof.text: Index the actual localization spectrum maps by all affine source free frames and positive-degree denominators. Generation at x gives a positive-degree image not in the maximal-ideal multiple. If its local coefficient were a nonunit, its germ would lie in the maximal ideal, and the coefficient equation would put the image germ in that multiple, a contradiction. Thus x lies in the basic open of the coefficient, which is the range of its localization spectrum map. These maps form an open cover, including for the empty source.

proof.text: Apply the overlap lemma to the explicitly constructed fraction maps and glue their spectrum morphisms using the open-cover gluing theorem. On each chart the scalar equation, away-chart structural formula, and naturality of the affine spectrum identifications give compatibility with h. Open-cover hom extensionality gives the global structural equation. Every prescribed fraction chart is one of the indices, so the gluing equation supplies its required factorization.

Take the explicitly constructed ring map for every supplied frame and denominator; its fraction and scalar formulas and the gluing equation give all remaining clauses.

theorem graded_line_homogeneous_fraction_atlas {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S)
    (A : S.GradedAlgebraData) (L : T.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L) (hgen : ψ.GeneratesEverywhere)
    (P : ∀ {W : T.Opens}, Γ(L, W) → (n : ℕ) → Γ(L.tensorPow n, W))
    (hP0 : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)), P l 0 = unitSectionsEquiv W 1)
    (hPs : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ),
      P l (n + 1) = tmulSection l (P l n))
    (c : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens),
      W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 → Γ(L, W.1) → (n : ℕ) → A.grading U n → Γ(T, W.1))
    (hc : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l → ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U n),
      c U W hWU l n a • P l n =
        (L.tensorPow n).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ψ.component U n a)) :
    ∃ F : T ⟶ A.relProj, ψ.IsCanonicalMap F ∧
      ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
        (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l →
        ∀ (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (e : A.grading U d),
        ∃ ρ : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grading U) e.val →+*
            Localization.Away (c U W hWU l d e),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U (n • d)),
            ρ (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (A.grading U) e.property n a.val
                a.property) =
              Localization.mk (c U W hWU l (n • d) a)
                (⟨c U W hWU l d e ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩ :
                  Submonoid.powers (c U W hWU l d e))) ∧
          (∀ r : Γ(S, U.1),
            ρ (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (A.grading U)
                (Submonoid.powers e.val)
                ⟨algebraMap Γ(S, U.1) (A.obj U) r,
                  SetLike.algebraMap_mem_graded (A.grading U) r⟩) =
              algebraMap Γ(T, W.1) (Localization.Away (c U W hWU l d e))
                (h.appLE U.1 W.1 hWU r)) ∧
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap Γ(T, W.1) (Localization.Away (c U W hWU l d e)))) ≫
              W.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ W.1.ι) ≫ F =
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ) ≫
              Proj.awayι (A.grading U) e.val e.property hd ≫ A.relProjι U
